horizontal_support_policy: Retain all32 original section/date cases,all candidate scores/local maxima and all no-selection,gate/support-edge or primary-censored results. Do not retune gates,skip support gaps or substitute weaker interior profiles. Native coastal/topographic masks and a narrow channel resolved by few cells can censor/confound maxima. Directional geographic maxima do not independently validate current/branch identity or water masses.
vertical_operator: Frozen connected-layer tracing searches above/below each per-current seed on full native0-5000m support with adjacent finite brackets. Keep upper/lower contours,statuses,last supported bounds and paired span distinct. Selection endpoints,BSO salinity-selected350m core/50m analysis cutoff,observed Makassar100m mean peak,instrument limits,channel sills,bed and missing support are not physical current bottoms. Same-sign deep flow can connect;model span is not physical thickness. No pressure conversion or thermal/salinity classification.
processing_policy: Cloud-only sequential full-section acquisition,selection,threshold diagnosis,audit and tests on one idle CPU. Local metadata/code/source-PDF review/hash retention only;no local ocean-field processing/tests or runtime/UI/browser/server/native/WASM work. Separate source chunks honor unchanged2.5MB file limits.
revision_context: New quarterly North Cape/BSO and Makassar branch sources use their appropriate transverse axes. Mixed preflight delegates unchanged longitude/latitude geometry and jointly checks total targets before fields. One shared reservation/ledger aliases both frozen bounded read methods;no independent per-axis budget reset. Interval selection,component rotation,connected-layer math and both native audits remain frozen.
geometry_provenance: OSW partial fixed-longitude North Cape/BSO context at20,22,24,26E with70.5-73.5N gates;fixed-latitude Makassar context at1,2,3,4S with117.5-120E gates. column_selector: North Cape uses complete finite50-350m eastward90degree integral;Makassar50-200m southward180degree integral. Both require positive signed integral and core>10cm/s,held through depth. No positive surface gate,relative surface comparison or thermal/salinity gate. Greatest eligible integral wins;first native southern index on longitude cuts or western index on latitude cuts breaks ties. Gate/support-edge winners remain unresolved without weaker interior replacement.5/10/20cm/s sensitivities use their own qualifying seed at the same selected column.
temperature_policy: No temperature field retrieval or gate for these cases. Only velocity dataset and coordinates used.

Sum both frozen preflight counts under original250000pairs/7MBdecoded caps;3-150profiles,40levels,20000pairs/patch and5km native-axis tolerances remain.
